newsitem.title: USA: Ametek CEO forecasts higher EPS, revs in '97.
newsitem.headline: Ametek CEO forecasts higher EPS, revs in '97.

text.p: Ametek Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Walter Blankley said he expects the company's sales and earnings to improve in 1997.
He did not provide specific estimates and officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
The company Wednesday said it earned $0.40 per share compared with $0.33 per share in the year-earlier period.
The earnings came on revenue of $204 million, compared with $202 million a year ago.
For 1996, the company said it earned $1.57 per share, compared with $1.31 per share in 1995, on revenue of $869 million, compared with $837 million.
